description: Pension contributions under the National Pensions Act, 2008 (Act 766): 18.5% of basic salary (worker 5.5%, employer 13%), of which 13.5% goes to SSNIT (Tier 1) and 5% to the Tier 2 occupational scheme. Monthly insurable earnings between GHS 587.80 and GHS 69,000.00 for 2026.

sources.title: SSNIT Public Notice: Maximum and Minimum Insurable Earnings for 2026 (13 January 2026)
